To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the degree of the pulsed transverse current concentration on the surface of sheet metal between the contacts of power source with different geometric connection in the frequency range of 18..22 kHz depends on the method of connection of the contacts and the ratio of the distance between the points of contact and the transverse size of the connection band.
the current density transverse distributions in the linear tools of magnetic pulse attraction are non-uniform, and the current density is concentrated in a thin strip of the sheet metal.

the current transverse distribution is not uniform in the operating frequency band of linear tools of magnetic pulsing attraction of non magnetic metals, and its shape depends on the ratio of width of the band of current connection and the transverse dimension of the contact connection of the power source.

the experimental investigation of current distribution on the sheet metal surface between the contacts of the power supply with different geometry of connection.
the study of the current density distribution on the surface in the linear tools of magnetic pulse attraction of sheet metals.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the degree of the current concentration on the surface of sheet metal depends little on the temporal shape of the current, but depends significantly on the method of connection the power source contacts.
the current density distribution is not constant along the surface of the metal sheet.

the degree of the transverse concentration of the pulsed currents on the surface of sheet metal in the operating frequency ranges of the linear tools of magnetic attraction depends little on the temporal characteristics and significantly depends on the ratio of width of the band connecting the contacts and transverse dimensions of these contacts.
